translation: It is the same in the human abdomen: if one eats and drinks at irregular times, the stomach accumulates and becomes hot, and at times there is the disease of acid swallowing; the qi steams and turns sour, and over time it must produce bubbles. The bubbles are light and float, traveling ahead of the qi, circulating through the four limbs and the hundred orifices; the qi can turn back, but the small bubbles silt up, stop, and stick, accumulating day by day and becoming strips and lumps; wherever there are gaps and holes, they are blocked, and the hundred diseases arise. Drawing them, they can move; rubbing them, they disperse; this is the basis of the water blister theory.
